do.text: Give the screen one `primary` button for the action it exists for, and make the alternatives `outline` or `secondary`.

dont.text: Don't set two solid buttons side by side: neither reads as the main action, and Cancel looks as safe to press as Save.

do.text: Label a button with the verb and its object ("Save changes"), so it makes sense on its own and to a screen reader.

dont.text: Don't use a vague word ("OK", "Click here"): people have to read around the button to learn what it does.

title: Keep red for what cannot be undone

do.text: Use `destructive` for an action that deletes or cannot be undone, with a glyph that says so.

dont.text: Don't paint a safe action red: people learn to ignore the colour, and miss it when it matters.

title: Show the wait in the button

do.text: Pass `loading` while the action runs: the spinner sits in the button, presses are blocked and the wait is announced.

dont.text: Don't put a spinner beside a button that still takes presses: a second tap sends the action twice.
